confidence_notes: Food anchors use 2026 Frankfurt cost-of-living aggregates for meals, cappuccino and draft beer. The cocktail estimate follows a downtown-club average; wine is inferred from the local beer price because a robust citywide wine-by-the-glass figure was unavailable. Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate and varies sharply during trade fairs.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct city comparator was needed for food and drink. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of a major German business city with trade-fair demand.
